ANTIMICROBIAL PROPHYLAXIS AFTER ERCP WITH INCOMPLETE DRAINAGE

The risk of symptomatic infection is increased when drainage of the common bile

duct is incomplete or if dye is trapped in the biliary tract.  In such cases,

give antimicrobials for 5 days.

# INPATIENT ORDERS:

[Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h \($\) R,DI < OR >](psjzid-ciprofloxacin-500mg-po-q12h)

[Amoxicillin-clavulante 875/125 mg PO q12h \($\) R](psjzid-amox-clav-875-125mg-po-q12h)

# OUTPATIENT ORDERS:

[Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO BID for 5 days \($\) R,DI](psozid2-ciprofloxacin-5ds-500mg-po-bid)

[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO BID for 5 days \($\) R](psozid2-amox-clav-875-125mg-5ds-po-bid)
